summarize_replace_fences: summarize the python function replace_fences that converts MathML tags to LaTeX math delimiters
run_load_predictor: run the python function load_predictor to initialize a Surya RecognitionPredictor with a FoundationPredictor
run_inference: run the python function inference to perform LaTeX OCR on a cropped region of a PIL image using a bounding box
run_get_page_image: run the python function get_page_image to extract an RGB PIL image from a PDF page by number and DPI
run_page_counter: run the python function page_counter to count the total number of pages in a PDF file
